visual.name: atlasText
visual.description: Word cloud and ranked word list from phrases or free text, with stop words, rotation, sentiment or topic colors, flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Text_Desc: Words, phrases or free text (comments, reviews). Free text is split into words.
en-US.Role_Values_Desc: Optional. Sizes words (for example Mentions). Without it, words are sized by how often they appear.
en-US.Role_Color_Desc: Optional. Colors words on a gradient (for example Sentiment).
en-US.Landing_Line1: Add words, phrases or free text (comments, reviews) to Text. Add a Weight such as Mentions, or leave it empty to count words.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Add a Topic or a Color value (for example Sentiment) to color the words. Pick word cloud or ranked words in the Format pane.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There is more data than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual
